purpose: official corporate contact and basic portal guidance

routing.label: General company information
routing.answer: For general information about GNK ASG d.o.o., please use the public portal sections, GNK ASG Insights, or contact info@gnk-asg.hr.

routing.label: Public documents and sources
routing.answer: For public documents and source references, please open the Documents and Sources sections on gnk-asg.hr. Formal requests should be sent to info@gnk-asg.hr.

routing.label: Business cooperation
routing.answer: For cooperation proposals, please send a short written summary, company details and contact information to info@gnk-asg.hr.

routing.label: Media inquiry
routing.answer: For media inquiries, please send the question, publication name, deadline and contact details to info@gnk-asg.hr.

routing.label: Meeting request
routing.answer: For meeting requests, please send the proposed topic, participants and preferred time window to info@gnk-asg.hr.

routing.label: Portal technical issue
routing.answer: For portal technical issues, please send a screenshot, device/browser information and a short description to info@gnk-asg.hr.
